title: Depth milestone reached

title: New deepest point
visibleCue: A new personal depth record is visibly confirmed.
condition: A meaningful personal-best event beats the old record and its confirmation is visible. Choose one reaction if a milestone occurs too.
exclude: No repeated metres past the record and no second line for the same milestone.

title: Rocks about to fall nearby
visibleCue: A live rock danger marker overlaps your position.
condition: The player's actual danger area overlaps an active fall zone. Rocks have not already passed; the voice can start immediately.
exclude: No distant quake, safe shelter, finished fall, queued stale warning or competing speech.

title: Survived a quake near miss
visibleCue: Rocks stop after actually threatening you.
condition: This quake recorded personal danger-zone exposure or a near miss. The player survives; debris stops and safety holds for 3 seconds.
exclude: No distant quake, rumble alone, death, menu or renewed hazard.

title: Hardcore stress turns critical
visibleCue: The visible stress warning turns critical.

title: Hardcore stress returns to calm
visibleCue: Your critical stress warning visibly clears.

exclude: No ordinary refill, spawning calm, restored save or new threat.

title: A substantial haul
visibleCue: A fresh pickup fills the bag's visual indicator.

title: Back in Town after a deep trip
visibleCue: You emerge into Town after going at least 300 metres deep.
condition: A real deep expedition ends with a committed return summary. The player is above ground and Town is visible.
exclude: No short surface loop, underground teleport, menu, shop or NPC conversation. Daylight lines additionally require daylight.

title: A meaningful upgrade bought

title: Level gained

title: Campfire blessing ignited

title: Campfire grows

title: Worldroot grows
visibleCue: The tree's silhouette visibly grows.

title: Rare wandering thoughts
visibleCue: A quiet thought; no event required.

exclude: No NPC/shop dialogue, cinematics, narration, danger, menus, pause or hidden tab. Never catch up missed lines.
adapterStatus: Review specification; new and tightened gates are not wired.
